title: Software Engineer, Mid-Sr
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for Engineers with experience designing and building cloud-based solutions.  We work with our enterprise customer to design, implement and enhance custom software solutions.  The ideal candidate will be able to participate in the planning, presentation and delivery of new or existing software solutions. 

We have a dynamic and fast-paced environment.  We are crafting custom solutions, so you won’t stagnate building one product.  This requires you to have a desire to adapt quickly to new tools and languages.  Our team has a highly technical background that provides us the opportunity to produce solutions to a diverse set of problems in a wide variety of regulated and non-regulated industries.  We currently have active projects in:  FinTech, Transportation, Biomedical/Pharmaceutical, Energy, Education and Marketing.

Required Qualifications

  • A passion for crafting software solutions and a desire to grow your knowledge and skill

  • B.S. level technical degree or related experience

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong organizational, planning, and analytical skills

  • Highly collaborative and team oriented

  • Ability to lead a small team

  • Ability to keep to production schedules and work effectively with colleagues

  • Diverse knowledge of Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, OS X

  • Ability to work productively in Linux and Windows

  • 3+ years’ experience and comfort across a combination of Python, C#, JavaScript, node.js, HTML, CSS, Vue, React and Angular

  • 3+ years’ experience with SQL Server and/or Postgres

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise systems and their deployment

  • Experience assessing, optimizing, automating IT service processes

  • Ability to perform as full-stack developer

  • Experience with AWS and Azure services
